The photo shows scrambled eggs on a square white plate. I used the plate as the ruler, taking its diagonal-to-side width as about 22 cm.

The egg pile covers roughly 10 cm by 12 cm. It is about 2.5 cm high, and the footprint is irregular, so I estimate about 90 cm² of coverage. That gives roughly 90 × 2.2 ≈ 200 cm³, and the eggs are loosely packed, so I used about 0.8 g/cm³. That comes to about 160 g, which I adjusted down to 150 g.

Scrambled eggs cooked with some fat are around 165 kcal per 100 g. I did not see visible pooled fat, so I did not add a separate fat item.
